title: public-tree security repair
summary: Fixes from the 2026-10-17 external security review of v0.7.2 (29e0241): restore the .env example templates the strip-list regression deleted; add history-scan mode to the privacy scanner (tree-clean-but-history-dirty blind spot); pin YOLO weights to official ultralytics release with SHA256 verification; document the API_BIND=all plaintext escape hatch and remove shipped farm lat/lon defaults.
operator_provided_problem: Review findings: (1) v0.7.2 ships zero .example files (v0.7.1 shipped 4) because config.yaml strip_paths grew to include *.example; (2) camera password reachable in public git history via c1a1640/e03ab06 (pre-existing, predates v0.7.2; rotation deferred by operator decision - secure LAN; history scan + scrub still required); (3) quick_classifier.py downloads yolov8n.onnx from third-party yoobright/yolo-onnx with no checksum - official ultralytics v8.4.0 sha256=b2bc52f40e8e1c532427d5bde3575a5d5b571b739fab2c6df443733ed1589cbd, live operator model sha256=b4ee8cd940e37cb9287b29845fb7dad18b021f578884c45c02758891f19e0b3f matches neither; (4) FARMSURV_API_BIND=all resolves 0.0.0.0 plaintext HTTP undocumented; quiet_hours.py + time_of_day.py ship farm lat/lon as code defaults.
scope: scripts/release/config.yaml, scripts/check_no_private_data.py, scripts/hooks wiring, infra/quick_classifier.py, infra/quiet_hours.py, infra/time_of_day.py, README.md, *.example files.
design_constraints: github push is orchestrator+operator gated, never coder-side

stories.title: restore .example templates + fix strip-list regression
done_evidence: templates carry KEY names + comments only, no values

stories.title: history-scan mode in privacy scanner
done_evidence: --history mode scans git log -p patches for cred patterns + LAN IPs + lat/lon
hook wires mode via FARMSURV_HISTORY_SCAN=fail|warn (warn default until history scrub)
stories.no_go: do not rewrite git history in this card

stories.title: YOLO weights supply-chain pin + SHA256 verify
done_evidence: SHA256 verified after download, mismatch raises loudly
README install step with URL + hash + verify command
stories.no_go: do not swap the live model file

stories.title: document API_BIND=all plaintext risk + env-drive farm coordinates
done_evidence: README loud warning: all = 0.0.0.0 plaintext HTTP, no TLS
lat/lon defaults removed from code, read via env-required pattern
stories.no_go: worker does not add FARMSURV_LAT/LON to ~/.env (orchestrator activation)

verification_recipe: cd <INSTALL_DIR> && git ls-files '*.example' | wc -l && python3 scripts/check_no_private_data.py --history; echo rc=$?
results_interpretation: After all four: fresh clone has working templates, pre-push catches history leaks, model download is pinned/verified, property coordinates no longer ship in code. Credential rotation remains operator-scheduled; history scrub (filter-repo) is orchestrator-side after US-110b lands.
